<thought>Using the formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and ignoring O, for C10H12NO2 we have (2*10 + 2 + 1 - 12)/2 = (20 + 2 + 1 - 12)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the conventional integer result (ignoring the fractional part) is 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
